659:t_205:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「That's $$ティファ$$'s love! You wouldn't understand it!」

659:t_205:4.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Let's do this! I won't let something this gloomy swallow the world where $$ティファ$$ and I live!」

659:t_206:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「If we leave creatures like these alone, they'll swallow the Earth too!」

659:t_206:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「That's right! We will devour everything!」

659:t_206:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「We will devour you, devour all life, and eventually devour everything in the universe!」

659:t_206:3.en:
$$ロラン$$
「You...! Do you think you're the only ones alive in this universe?!」

659:t_206:4.en:
$$ロラン$$
「We have no choice! We're fighting to survive too!」

659:t_207:0.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「I can feel it! This one... Is he a forerunner of humanity's evolution?!」

659:t_207:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「If we devour him, we too will reach the truth and see the path to $$シンカ$$!」

659:t_207:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
(From evolution to $$シンカ$$... Watching these creatures, I'm beginning to understand what that means...)

659:t_207:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
(That's exactly why I can't let these creatures, these masses of pure ego, destroy humanity...! I'll stop them here!)

659:t_208:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You creatures do nothing but take lives to satisfy your own desires...! There's no place for you in this universe!」

659:t_208:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「We have no intention of begging permission from the likes of you!」

659:t_208:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「We are emissaries of the Great Void! In time, we will decide everything in this universe!」

659:t_208:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If your bloated egos will destroy everything in the universe...!」

659:t_208:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Then I'll stop you here, so the universe can be filled with life!」

659:t_209:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Taking a life means taking away everything, including its potential to evolve! Why can't you understand that?!」

659:t_209:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「You needn't worry. We will evolve in your place.」

659:t_209:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「We are the only creatures this universe needs. Yes... We alone are absolute!」

659:t_209:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I won't hand our potential over to creatures like these!」

659:t_209:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「We'll live... We'll survive! We have to see where humanity's inner potential leads!」

659:t_210:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「You've abandoned mutual understanding! You're the enemies of every living thing in this universe!」

659:t_210:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Don't think you can assimilate us as you did the writhing metal!」

659:t_210:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「We are absolute! All other life is meaningless before our will!」

659:t_210:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「So this is $$バアル$$... An enemy that rejects mutual understanding...」

659:t_210:4.en:
$$刹那$$
「Then I won't hesitate! Fighting enemies like you is my new mission!」

659:t_211:0.en:
$$シン$$
「If you want to take lives that badly... If you want a fight, I'll take you on!」

659:t_211:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「You presumptuous brat. Don't imagine the likes of you can stand against us.」

659:t_211:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「But your power interests us. Come, become one with us!」

659:t_211:3.en:
$$シン$$
「I'll never become anything like you! I'll never be someone who spreads war and makes others miserable without feeling any pain!」

659:t_211:4.en:
$$シン$$
「Here I go! You do nothing but spread war, and I won't let you do as you please with this universe!」

659:t_212:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「I... We're fighting to protect life!」

659:t_212:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「You will learn how meaningless that is.」

659:t_212:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「We will devour all life. And then we will become the one absolute existence.」

659:t_212:3.en:
$$キラ$$
「If words can't reach you anymore... I won't hesitate to fight!」

659:t_212:4.en:
$$キラ$$
「If you refuse to acknowledge other life, I'll fight to stop you!」

659:t_213:0.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$バアル$$! You block the path to the future for humanity... No, for all life!」

659:t_213:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「No. We are saying we will give you a future.」

659:t_213:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「You will gain it by becoming one with us. There is nothing to fear.」

659:t_213:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「All you're doing is painting over our future with your self-serving logic!」

659:t_213:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「I cannot accept your existence! Fighting you is my mission!」

659:t_214:0.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「So another fool who doesn't know their place dares to challenge us.」

659:t_214:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Soldiers who do nothing but follow orders are pitiful creatures!」

659:t_214:2.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Fighting you isn't an assignment. It's the duty of everyone who lives.」

659:t_214:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I've confirmed the target...! My target is the giant $$インベーダー#robot$$!」

659:t_215:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「I have no mercy to spare for villains who've declared their intent to commit genocide!」

659:t_215:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「I don't care how big you are! I'll dispose of you swiftly!」

659:t_215:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「This one...! Does he feel no fear in the face of our grandeur?!」

659:t_215:3.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Impossible...! Does he fail to understand the situation?!」

659:t_215:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「I have no reason to let stupid vermin call me a fool!」

659:t_215:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「I can already see how to win! All that's left is to carry it out!」

659:t_216:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(Truth... $$シンカ$$... Have they inflated their egos this much in pursuit of them...?)

659:t_216:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(But unless we reach that point too, we may not be able to fight them...!)

659:t_216:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「You seem unable to speak in our presence.」

659:t_216:3.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Naturally. That is a human's normal reaction.」

659:t_216:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You're just oversized vermin...! It's too early to think you've won just because you gained the power of this Great Void!」

659:t_216:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I've already devised a tactic to turn this situation around! Know that you have no chance of victory!」

659:t_217:0.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「I've found you, $$異能生存体$$!」

659:t_217:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「We will make your existence, which transcends causality, our own power!」

659:t_217:2.en:
$$キリコ$$
(You're pitiful creatures possessed by battle too.)

659:t_217:3.en:
$$キリコ$$
(But I can't give you my life.)

659:t_218:0.en:
$$桂$$
「I don't know about your Great Void or $$シンカ$$, but you clearly don't understand society's basic rule: don't cause trouble for others!」

659:t_218:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「You $$始原の特異点$$! You have no right to say that after breaking the greatest taboo!」

659:t_218:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「But we are grateful. By destroying the barrier of space-time, you made it possible for us to seize everything!」

659:t_218:3.en:
$$桂$$
「So it's my fault these creatures are running rampant too...」

659:t_218:5.en:
$$桂$$
「Don't worry, $$モーム$$. I'm used to villains like these trying to pin the blame on me.」

659:t_218:6.en:
$$桂$$
「But I'll settle the score! I'll unload every last round into them!」

659:t_219:0.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「A $$スフィア$$! If only we had its power!」

659:t_219:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Then we could make everything in this universe ours!」

659:t_219:2.en:
$n
「I can't hand my $$いがみ合う双子$$ over to creatures like these!」

659:t_219:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You are our... No, you're the enemies of every living thing!」

659:t_219:4.en:
$n
「We're alive! That power will smash even your Great Void!」

659:t_220:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「Get ready, you $$インベーダー#pilot$$ ringleader! Don't think we'll give up just because there are more of you!」

659:t_220:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「You brat! Your cockiness ends here!」

659:t_220:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「No one can defeat us within the Great Void!」

659:t_220:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「Who's the cocky one here?! You cheating bastard!」

659:t_220:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「I'll settle our score from the $$再世戦争$$ right here!」

659:t_221:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「A species that envies other life and wants prosperity only for itself has no future!」

659:t_221:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「This is bad...! This is very bad!」
